entrypoints.rule: files whose role classifies as `entrypoint` via classify_file (filename convention: main.rs/__main__.py/index.js/Program.cs/Main.kt/index.php/main.swift, or an AST-detected main / canonical entry symbol); 11 found

unreachable.rule: no caller path from a declared entrypoint: no file reachable from an entrypoint names the symbol, and its defining file is not itself an entrypoint (reachability computed from 11 declared entrypoint file(s))

unlinked.rule: reachable from a declared entrypoint, but no test file names the symbol and no COV-2 coverage link targets it (reachability computed from 11 declared entrypoint file(s))

ok.rule: reachable from a declared entrypoint AND carries a coverage link (reachability computed from 11 declared entrypoint file(s))

unknown.rule: every source file in the corpus is in a language with a public-function extractor (rust, go, python, typescript, javascript); nothing was left unaudited

census.extractor: tree-sitter go: function_declaration / method_declaration whose name starts uppercase
tree-sitter python: function_definition whose name does not start with `_`

rules: public function: Rust bare `pub fn`, Go exported func/method (leading uppercase), Python `def`/`async def` not starting with `_`, TypeScript/JavaScript declarations inside an `export`
declared entrypoint: `classify_file` role == `entrypoint` (code-derived, no hand list)

reachable: the defining file is itself a declared entrypoint, or a file reachable-from-an-entrypoint names the symbol; file reachability is the forward closure of `A names a public symbol of B` from the entrypoints
reference: lexical identifier occurrence in the file text (comments and strings included) — over-approximate by construction, so `unreachable` is a conservative no-false-positive claim
linked: a test file (is_test_file rules) names the symbol, or an on-disk COV-2 coverage link targets the symbol's name or file
test files and generated files define no audited symbol (they are the link source and machine output); their language is still counted in the census
